title: Star Schemas, Facts & Dimensions
interviewAnswer: A star schema separates measurable events in fact tables from descriptive entities in dimensions. Grain must be defined first; many analytical errors come from joining tables at inconsistent grain.
why: Star Schemas, Facts & Dimensions appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: A star schema separates measurable events in fact tables from descriptive entities in dimensions. Grain must be defined first; many analytical errors come from joining tables at inconsistent grain. Dimensions describe who/what/where. Slowly changing dimensions preserve history. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: One row per order-line fact joined to customer/product/date dimensions.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Star Schemas, Facts & Dimensions make?
How would you validate or debug Star Schemas, Facts & Dimensions in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
